Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.submission

Record Class OrderSubmissionRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.submission.OrderSubmissionRequest
Record Components:
accountId - the account to trade in
symbol - the instrument's symbol, used when instrumentId is absent
instrumentId - the instrument's ID
side - BUY or SELL
quantity - the whole-share quantity
quotedPrice - the price the client was quoted when placing the order
maxSlippagePercent - the price tolerance in percent for this order, overriding the account's saved one; requires quotedPrice
orderType - MARKET (when null), LIMIT, STOP, STOP_LIMIT or TRAILING_STOP
limitPrice - the worst price to fill at, for LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT orders
stopPrice - the price that sets a STOP or STOP_LIMIT order working
timeInForce - DAY (when null) or GTC, for orders other than MARKET
trailAmount - for TRAILING_STOP: how many dollars behind the best price the stop trails
trailPercent - for TRAILING_STOP: how many percent behind the best price the stop trails; give this or trailAmount
bracketTakeProfitPrice - for a BUY: the limit price of the sell order opened to take profit once the buy fills; give this with bracketStopLossPrice
bracketStopLossPrice - for a BUY: the stop price of the sell order opened to cut losses once the buy fills; whichever sell executes first cancels the other
extendedHours - whether the order may also trade in pre-market and after-hours; null means no
public record OrderSubmissionRequest(@NotNull(message="accountId is required") UUID accountId, String symbol, UUID instrumentId, Order.Side side, @jakarta.validation.constraints.Min(value=1L, message="quantity must be at least 1 whole share") long quantity, @Positive(message="quotedPrice must be greater than zero") BigDecimal quotedPrice, @DecimalMin(value="0.00",message="maxSlippagePercent must be between 0 and 10") @DecimalMax(value="10.00",message="maxSlippagePercent must be between 0 and 10") @Digits(integer=2,fraction=2,message="maxSlippagePercent may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal maxSlippagePercent, Order.OrderType orderType, @Positive(message="limitPrice must be greater than zero") @Digits(integer=12,fraction=2,message="limitPrice may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal limitPrice, @Positive(message="stopPrice must be greater than zero") @Digits(integer=12,fraction=2,message="stopPrice may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal stopPrice, Order.TimeInForce timeInForce, @Positive(message="trailAmount must be greater than zero") @Digits(integer=12,fraction=2,message="trailAmount may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal trailAmount, @DecimalMin(value="0.10",message="trailPercent must be between 0.1 and 50") @DecimalMax(value="50.00",message="trailPercent must be between 0.1 and 50") @Digits(integer=2,fraction=2,message="trailPercent may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal trailPercent, @Positive(message="bracketTakeProfitPrice must be greater than zero") @Digits(integer=12,fraction=2,message="bracketTakeProfitPrice may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal bracketTakeProfitPrice, @Positive(message="bracketStopLossPrice must be greater than zero") @Digits(integer=12,fraction=2,message="bracketStopLossPrice may have at most two decimal places") BigDecimal bracketStopLossPrice, Boolean extendedHours) extends Record
Request payload for submitting an order. Supports whole-share trading: quantity must be at least 1 whole share.

Market orders (the default) always fill at the live quote. quotedPrice is only the price the client was shown; when a price tolerance applies - maxSlippagePercent, or else the account's saved one - the order is rejected if the fill price is further than that from quotedPrice.

Order types: LIMIT, STOP and STOP_LIMIT orders wait OPEN until the market reaches their price, for as long as timeInForce allows (DAY when not given). A limit price already caps the fill, so price tolerance applies to market orders only.
